name: Ruze Selen El Philizar
original_name: リュゼ・セレン・エル＝フィリアザール
source:
Favorite food: Cold Potage, シオカラーノ
Disliked food: Maple syrup

The prince of Serenfaen, Mea's older brother. A boy with idol charisma loved by everyone in the country.
